entities.name: Hungry Mist
entities.description: Elemental mist of Ulgrotha, a silent predator given life and hunger by the Autumn Willow to protect the Great Wood.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: Being who gave the Hungry Mist life and hunger.

entities.name: Koskun Mountains
entities.description: Home of the goblins the Mist guards against.

entities.name: An-Havva
entities.description: Settlement whose citizens keep children in at night.

entities.name: Onella
entities.description: Home of the first pioneers who named the Hungry Mist.

events.summary: The Autumn Willow gives the Hungry Mist life and hunger to patrol the forest against trespassing goblins.
events.quote: It was given life and hunger by the Autumn Willow

relations.quote: It was given life and hunger by the Autumn Willow
